newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic releases pacemakers in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic releases pacemakers in Europe.

text.p: Medtronic Inc said Wednesday it released in Europe its Medtronic.Kappa 400 Series, a new generation of pacemakers designed to adjust heart rate therapy settings to match patient activity patterns without requiring a hospital or clinic visit.
It said the line includes a dual chamber model that regulates the upper and lower chambers of the heart, as well as a single chamber model that regulates either the lower or upper chambers.
Medtronic said the Medtronic.Kappa devices feature expanded system memory and a lead management system that monitors pacing lead integrity and reconfigures pacing and sensing polarities when needed.
Medtronic is a medical technology company.
